title: Radio Linear Polarization of GRB Afterglows: Instrumental Systematics in ALMA Observations of GRB 171205A
question: Is the linear polarization of the GRB 171205A radio afterglow claimed by Urata et al. detected, or is it an ALMA instrumental systematic?

data.sensitivity: rms ≈7.3 uJy in Q, U, V (full data)

what.value: Previously claimed ALMA linear polarization (0.27±0.04)% and VLA cm spectral index 1.46±0.03

evidence.quote: claimed a detection of $(0.27\pm0.04)\%$ linear polarization in the radio afterglow of GRB 171205A

what.value: Compilation of radio polarization limits of other GRBs

evidence.quote: Our compiled sample of radio linear polarization observations includes one detection (cite: lag+19), and several upper limits

external_data.citation: (cite: tfk+98; fyb+03; gt05; tfbk04; vdhpdb+14; lag+19)

recipe.goal: Regenerate QA2 data and test stability
recipe.method: Run archive calibration scripts, image Stokes IQUV, fit point source with imfit, split by sideband and by SB execution
Tsys/wvr, bandpass, qufromgain, XYf+QU in gaincal, xyamb, polcal for D-terms, repeated with two reference antennas
key_parameters: cross-hand delays from scan 61 on polarization calibrator
assumptions: Stokes V of polarization calibrator negligible

recipe.method: Phase-only then amp+phase self-cal per sideband, tclean imaging, imfit point source fits to IQUVP
key_parameters: amp solint 20 min, 14 solutions per pol per antenna, cross-hand phase fixed

recipe.goal: Quantify systematic uncertainty and upper limit
recipe.method: Use gain calibrator polarization variation across SB executions; range of three Gaussian draws gives 1σ systematic, combined with statistical error; Rician bias
assumptions: Gain calibrator intrinsic polarization constant over observations; systematic is Gaussian

recipe.goal: Interpret limit with jet magnetic field models
recipe.method: Compare with Granot & Taylor 2005 toroidal models and patch-coherence estimate

answer_key.quantity: 3σ upper limit on linearly polarized intensity

evidence.quote: We derive a 3$\sigma$ upper limit on the linearly polarized intensity of $P<97.2~\mu$Jy

answer_key.quantity: 3σ upper limit on fractional linear polarization

evidence.quote: This yields a linear polarization measurement of $41.7\pm32.4~\mu$Jy (undebiased)

answer_key.quantity: Stokes I flux density (all data, self-calibrated)

evidence.quote: for which we derive a value of $32.44\pm0.03$ mJy (statistical error)

not_stated_but_needed: Number of clean iterations, threshold and masks for tclean
Exact flagging selections beyond DV22 and the specific spectral window
Whether the reduction scripts and CASA version for the manual reduction match 5.6.1
score_reason: Public data, detailed recipe and numeric tables; some tclean/flagging details missing.
rediscovery_reason: Public archival data, step-by-step recipe, numeric results in tables.
